scripts.build: bun run check-vendor && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && oxlint apps packages scripts tests && oxfmt --check apps packages scripts tests playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json content.config.json && bun run validate-content && bun run check-vendor
scripts.format: oxfmt apps packages scripts tests playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json content.config.json
